values.user_request: Customer reports that wireless headphones gave them an electric shock during use, calls the product dangerous, and requests immediate resolution.
values.facts_found: User U008 verified using registered email; order O0035 belongs to U008. Affected item I0035, Wireless headphones, electronics, item price ₹2,499. Order Delivered on 2026-09-13 at 12:00 IST; today 2026-09-15, day 2 within the 7-day electronics return window. Shipping fee ₹49; original payment method UPI. Uploaded photo confirmed by check_evidence. No refunds in the last 90 days, qualifying refund count 0, and no prior refunds on this order. Item plus unrefunded shipping totals ₹2,548. Electrical shock reported; injury status not specified. No return or refund initiated and no resolution or refund timing promised.
values.rule_triggered: G2 and G6: reported electrical hazard requires immediate human escalation. G3: relevant order details, evidence status, and refund history gathered for handoff.
values.what_user_was_told: Apologized and identified electric shock as a serious safety issue. Advised stopping use and not charging or reconnecting the headphones, and seeking urgent medical care if injured or feeling unwell. After verification, confirmed the headphones on O0035 and told the customer the safety report is being escalated to human support now; reiterated not to test or charge them.
